description:
After DNS cache and redirect policy are extracted, CrestHttpClient should
contain only:

  - class state: @config, @validator, @request_semaphore, @semaphore_lock
  - public API: head, get, build_headers, with_cache, clear_rate_limiters
  - private: perform_request, ensure_semaphore, create_semaphore_internal,
    acquire_semaphore, release_semaphore, build_tls_context,
    ensure_ssl_bypass_acknowledged, convert_response
  - DNS integration: a single call to DnsCache.check_rebinding(url) (or
    DnsCache.instance.check_rebinding) replacing the existing
    verify_dns_rebinding call.
  - Redirect integration: a single call to RedirectPolicy#follow(...)
    replacing the existing handle_redirects call.

Target line count: ~200 lines (down from 531).

Specific issues to fix in the shrunken client:

  - perform_request currently has a top-level rescue chain that records
    circuit-breaker failures for *any* error. After the split, the
    DnsCache check happens before the circuit breaker check, so a DNS
    error gets counted against the circuit breaker even though it was a
    SSRF mitigation, not a server outage. Decide: should DNS rebinding
    failures count for circuit breaking? Probably no, since the server
    didn't fail.
  - check_ssrf currently calls both @validator.valid?(url) and
    @validator.resolve_and_validate(url). The latter does DNS resolution
    and is a side effect, but if rebinding_check is on we'll do DNS
    resolution again in verify_dns_rebinding. Combine into a single
    pre-flight check that the new RedirectPolicy can also call.
  - The class method clear_rate_limiters delegates to
    RateLimiterRegistry.clear. It belongs in RateLimiterRegistry, not
    here. Move or document.
  - The class method build_headers delegates to HeaderBuilder.build.
    Same - it belongs in HeaderBuilder, not here. Move.
  - The class method with_cache is a generic HTTP helper, not specific
    to this client. Consider whether it belongs on a separate
    CacheHeaders helper module.

Test impact:

  spec/crest_http_client_spec.cr (987B) and spec/crest_http_client_di_spec.cr
  (2KB) are the closest unit tests. After all extractions, the client should
  be exercisable in <50 lines of setup.
title: Shrink CrestHttpClient to request execution only
